rationale: All six prior blocking findings were graded against current source and the id-mapped decisions: CR-001, CR-002, CR-004 and CR-006 are resolved by source, CR-005 by the recorded accept-and-document decision, and CR-003 by the architecture.md exception plus removing the util-to-hook import (its own file openSignInWindow.ts is untouched, hence medium confidence). No new findings were sought; business_review and standards_review are carried forward unchanged from the final round (U4, AC1 and code-quality still partial there, AC2 and AC7 pending-stage-7), tests were not re-run, and the brief was written.

business_review.item: U1 openSignInWindow util: sync window.open, opener=null, http(s)-only validation, opened/blocked/invalid_url result
business_review.notes: openSignInWindow.ts has no React import; INVALID_AUTH_URL_MESSAGE added; tests cover opened, blocked, javascript: and garbage urls

business_review.item: U2 watchSignInWindow util: 500 ms closed poll, 3 s /status poll, immediate check on close, 600 s silent cap, generalized beacon
business_review.notes: Uses fetchMCPAuthStatus; timeout beacon body unchanged; early-close beacon phase=window_closed_before_callback; closed-check fragility tracked in CR-004

business_review.item: U3 Idempotent success across listener instances; only the opening instance starts a watcher
business_review.notes: Hook onSuccess no-ops on an authenticated row; chat markPromptAuthSuccess is idempotent; tests cover poll plus postMessage

business_review.item: U4 Watcher lifecycle: stopped on success, error, early close, cancel, re-auth, unmount, row removal, chat clear/switch
business_review.notes: Chat onTimeout -> rollbackPromptAuthRow stops the watcher at the 60 s hint while the hook keeps polling to 600 s (CR-002); chat switch over-stops (CR-001)

business_review.item: U5 Popup-blocked handling at all four call sites via the util, recoverable status on every path
business_review.notes: Hook and chat store map blocked to POPUP_BLOCKED_AUTH_MESSAGE; tests cover SAML initiate and initiatePromptAuth blocked

business_review.item: U6 Early close: recoverable status, ticket message verbatim, sign_in_window_closed flag, beacon, spinner leaves within ~1 s
business_review.notes: Message constant matches ticket; flag set in hook and chat store; 500 ms poll plus immediate status check; beacon sent in handleWindowClosed

business_review.item: U7 'Open sign-in in a new tab' label on the existing authenticate button via row.sign_in_window_closed
business_review.notes: Label swap on Authenticate and Re-authenticate buttons; flag reset on successful open; AssistantAuthGateRow tests

business_review.item: U8 Untracked-id console.warn downgraded to console.debug; bad-shape and origin warns kept
business_review.notes: Listener change plus assertions that debug is called and warn is not; origin warn retained

business_review.item: U9 Timers and postMessage handling untouched; early-close row leaves tracked set
business_review.notes: No listener timer or postMessage change; closed rows excluded from liveAuthConfigIds in hook and chat; tests present

business_review.item: B1 Callback page no-opener success: beacon, window.close() unless KEEP_TAB_OPEN, 300 ms fallback text, opener path unchanged
business_review.notes: _callback_pages.py no-opener branch uses CALLBACK_FALLBACK_DELAY_MS=300; braces doubled; three script tests; beacon side effect in CR-006

business_review.item: B2 /status for discovered flows returns authenticated after the callback stores the token; no change
business_review.notes: Existing discovered-status bridge test covers store_token=True -> authenticated

business_review.item: B3 Diagnostics: no model change; phase=window_closed_before_callback logs at WARNING with the phase
business_review.notes: phase= appended to the log line; test added for window_closed_before_callback

business_review.item: Watchers are stopped on every terminal path; none leak
business_review.notes: Each path asserted in hook and chat tests; over-stopping on chat hint and switch tracked as CR-002 and CR-001

business_review.item: Non-http(s) auth_url never reaches location.href
business_review.notes: isHttpUrl gate before location.href; test asserts href stays empty and the window closes for javascript: and unparsable input

business_review.item: Two concurrent listeners or poll plus postMessage produce exactly one success handling
business_review.notes: Hook onSuccess guard plus chat idempotence; tests 'marks success once' and 'stops the watcher once'

business_review.item: Tests for helper, watcher, hook, listener, chat prompt auth, row component, callback script, diagnostics
business_review.notes: All listed suites added or updated; no remaining mockReturnValue(window) in codemie-ui src

business_review.item: Non-goal: no change to the 60 s / 600 s timers or postMessage validation
business_review.notes: Listener changes limited to the beacon generalization and warn->debug

business_review.item: Non-goal: no new backend endpoints, status values or diagnostics model fields
business_review.notes: Backend diff is the callback script, one log-line suffix and tests

business_review.item: Non-goal: no change to SharePoint popups, tool-OAuth flows or broker-login window.open
business_review.notes: None of those files appear in the change set

business_review.item: AC1 MCP OAuth sign-in completes from assistant editor and from chat when the IdP renders a page, no manual workaround
business_review.notes: Editor keeps polling past the 60 s hint; chat stops its watcher at the hint with no postMessage fallback, so slow IdP steps are never detected (CR-002); real IdP run owed to Stage 7

business_review.item: AC2 window.opener is null on every page of the flow
business_review.notes: opener=null set before navigation and unit-tested with a fake window; manual Chrome check against an opener guard page owed to Stage 7

business_review.item: AC3 Popup-blocked detection still shows POPUP_BLOCKED_AUTH_MESSAGE
business_review.notes: Null handle -> blocked -> POPUP_BLOCKED_AUTH_MESSAGE in hook and chat store; tests in both

business_review.item: AC4 Success detected without window.opener.postMessage, incl. cross-origin callback and KEEP_TAB_OPEN=true
business_review.notes: Completion comes from /status polling via api.get; keep-tab-open branch shows the message; script tests cover both flag values

business_review.item: AC5 Early close: spinner leaves within ~1 s, message with 'Open sign-in in a new tab', backend logs early-close at WARNING
business_review.notes: 500 ms poll plus immediate status check; message and label wired; result=error beacon hits logger.warning with the phase

business_review.item: AC6 Completing sign-in via 'Open sign-in in a new tab' is detected automatically and the re-run happens exactly once
business_review.notes: Reopen goes through openSignInWindow and watchSignInWindow; onSuccess guard plus untouched isRetryingRef give a single re-run

business_review.item: AC7 Happy path unchanged: success within ~2 s, single success handling, no duplicate re-runs
business_review.notes: Unit-tested single handling; real-browser timing, and the 3 s poll fallback when close is blocked, need Stage 7 evidence

business_review.item: AC8 No warn-level untracked auth_config_id log on a successful callback
business_review.notes: Listener uses console.debug; test asserts warn not called with that message

business_review.item: AC9 Unit tests added or updated for helper, hook, listener, chat prompt auth, callback script no-opener branch
business_review.notes: openSignInWindow, useMCPAuthPrompt, useAuthCallbackListener, chatGeneration.promptAuth and test_oauth2_callback_bridge tests present

standards_review.notes: codemie: 1 subject matches EPMCDME-####: Description. codemie-ui: 6 subjects match the CI regex in standards/git-workflow.md.
codemie: pass. codemie-ui: no code-quality guide; architecture.md:63 (Utils must not trigger side effects) broken by openSignInWindow.ts and watchSignInWindow.ts (CR-003).
codemie: postMessage bound to targetOrigin, no-opener branch posts nothing, log values sanitized. codemie-ui: opener cut, http(s)-only navigation, event.origin and payload shape checks kept.

finding_status.notes: stopAllPromptAuthWatchers and its cleanup effect are gone; watcher outcomes resolve the opening chat via getOpenedChatById (current chat, else openedChatsHistory, which setOpenChat keeps for a pending gate).
onTimeout now calls showPromptAuthHint, which updates the row without stopSignInWatcher; a later watcher success still marks authenticated and is covered by a test.

architecture.md:65 records the Utils exception and watchSignInWindow.ts no longer imports a hook (beacon moved to utils/mcpAuthDiagnostics.ts, which imports only utils/api). The finding's own file openSignInWindow.ts is unchanged.
checkStatusAfterClose retries a failed fetch up to 3 times, 1 s apart; an explicit non-authenticated status still ends at once. Tests cover retry-then-success, all-failed and stop() mid-retry.
fix_evidence maps decision (a) accept and document with a non-empty rationale; the limit is commented in _callback_pages.py and watchSignInWindow.ts and pinned by tests on both sides.
The no-opener success beacon sends opener_present: null (Object.assign overrides the false default), so the 'is False' check misses and it logs INFO; a new test covers it.
